observed_failure: Multiple ranks throw std::length_error: cannot create std::vector larger than max_size(); process abort, exit134.
finding: Ceil partitioning at n=1031 and 128 ranks uses chunks of nine, giving ranks115-127 start>n while end is clamped to n. BodyRange::size() subtracts these size_t values without clamping. The underflow becomes a negative int sendCount and then an enormous vector size in syncBodies; receive counts have the same defect.
interpretation: Pre-existing empty-partition unsigned-underflow defect independent of concurrent scheduling. Retain failed external validation without retry.
investigation: Static source/count/allocation inspection and retained exception diagnostic; no new program execution.
